text: These wireless hosts, whatever they are, as we said, they may be connected through a wireless link with a point of access. The point of access may be a Wi-Fi access point. It could be also a cellular base station. It could be a Bluetooth another Bluetooth device that acts, I would say, as a point of access, as a gateway. May be different things, but typically, typically, this point of access is connected to the wired part of the system, that is the infrastructure, and then from there to the internet. Wireless link. The wireless link is the communication link that, as we said, connects the wireless hosts with a point of access, or as already mentioned, it can connect to mobile hosts directly. The wireless link may be of different type depending on the wireless technology that we are using to provide connectivity. Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, cellular, and so on. Okay, so that said, these essentially are our elements of the network.
